jei.entropica.info.amber_chunk:
Amber Chunks are harvested by stripping the bark off Amber Logs or Amber Wood using an Axe.

Used in alchemical distils, wand foci, arcana book binding, and crystal alchemy.
jei.entropica.info.diluted_essence:
Diluted Essence Fluid is capable of transforming matter.

To create it, simply toss raw Essence items directly into a pool of Water.

Once the water transforms into Diluted Essence Fluid, you can toss specific items into the fluid to trigger transformations.
jei.entropica.info.dynamic_weapon_crafti:
To forge a Dynamic Weapon, you must place a Shape Concept, a Core, an Orbis Acceptor, and 4 Base Material Ingots in the center of the Eidolic Lathe.

Optionally, surround it with up to 16 modifiers (like Spell Gems or Quartz) on Attunement Pedestals.

Pipe between 500 and 100,000 Materia Fumus into the Lathe to begin forging!

codex.entropica.entry.firmament_weaver.o:
Overview & Description:
The Firmament Weaver channels ambient Materia into elastic, iridescent forcefield membranes. These non-block spatial boundaries deflect kinetic velocity, filter authorized entities, and dynamically snap to architecture.
codex.entropica.entry.firmament_weaver.c:
Origin & Obtaining:
Crafted at a crafting table using Astral Brass Rods, an Astral Crystal, and a Refractive Astral Lens.
codex.entropica.entry.firmament_weaver.u:
Weaving & Configuration:
Right-click block corners to define Point A and Point B for seamless Two-Point Drag & Snap spanning. Sneak-interact with a placed barrier to open the Celestial Configuration Screen to set filter modes, bounce elasticity, one-way directional flow, and player whitelists.
codex.entropica.entry.firmament_weaver.m:
Special Properties:
Barriers do not occupy block voxels, allowing blocks and machines to be placed directly through them. Fast-approaching entities experience continuous collision detection and elastic velocity reflection.
Omnidirectional kinetic launch pad utilizing localized anti-gravity impulses with fall-damage immunity and redstone scaling.
Celestial pneumatic propulsion fixture providing gravity-relative upward launching.
codex.entropica.entry.graviton_bouncepad:
Overview & Description:
The Graviton Bouncepad adapts to the traveler's active gravitational vector. Rather than launching along the world's fixed vertical axis, it calculates the entity's current downward gravity and reflects momentum in the exact opposite direction (-g).

Origin & Obtaining:
Crafted using Astral Brass Plates, a standard Piston, and a Gravitational Anchor core.

Deployment & Control:
Mountable on floors, walls, or ceilings. Stepping onto the membrane completely negates landing fall damage. Applying a redstone signal supercharges internal graviton springs from 1.35 m/s to 2.20 m/s.

Special Properties:
Perfect for inverted gravity ceiling traversal, asteroid gravity centers, and vertical pneumatic transit shafts.

codex.entropica.node.spellcrafting_works: Design modular Spell Parchment blueprints at the Arcane Scribing Table and safely socket, temper, or engrave Spellgems at the Runic Anvil.
Core physical workstations for designing, duplicating, recycling, and socketing Spellgems.
codex.entropica.entry.spellcrafting_work:
Overview & Description:
Spellcrafting relies on dedicated arcane workstations. The Arcane Scribing Table lets you assemble modular Spell Parchments with custom Flow Modifiers, Delivery Forms, Core Effects, Materia assignments, and Signature Mutations, while the Runic Anvil handles zero-risk Spellgem socketing, alloy fuel tempering, and melee weapon/tool spell engraving.

Arcane Scribing Table:
Supply Blank Parchment and Arcane Scribing Ink to inscribe new Spell Parchments, duplicate fully researched blueprints, or scrub unwanted non-Unique Spellgems back into Blank Spellgems. Unresearched Cryptic glyphs can be tested blindly, though their Signature Mutations remain locked until finalized at a Research Bench.

Runic Anvil & Casting Apparatuses:
Right-click the Runic Anvil with an Arcanum Focus (1 gem), Wand (2 gems), Staff (4 gems), or Grimoire (9 gems) and a Spellgem in your Off-Hand for a 100% safe, zero-lockout swap. Right-clicking with a sword or tool and a Blank Spellgem engraves a casting socket, while Arcanite (+5%), Viscanite (+12%), Resonite (+20%), or Charged Alloys (+30%) temper Materia efficiency.
Grow Blank Spellgems via Starlight Condensation or crystal soaking, and automate spellcasting with Stone, Marble, Quartz, and Astral Slate Autocast Pedestals.
Stationary Materia-fueled spell turrets and utility automation nodes.
codex.entropica.entry.autocast_pedestals:
Obtaining Blank Spellgems:
Blank Spellgems can be formed swiftly by condensing Starlight onto Glass at an Astral Collector, Astral Infusion Pedestal, or Resonance Starlight Fountain, or grown in bulk by dropping Spellgem Crystal Seeds into water for 10 minutes.

Autocast Pedestal Operation:
Mount any Inscribed Spellgem or Casting Apparatus into an Autocast Pedestal and supply an Orbis Cell (in its fuel slot or placed directly adjacent). Configure the cast timer (1.0s to 60.0s), vertical aim pitch, and Redstone control mode. Sneak-right-click a chest with a Casting Apparatus and then sneak-right-click the pedestal to link item collection!

tooltip.entropica.comet_ribbonfish: Caught only in Astral Skerries. Quickens a Starlight Nautilus's Star-Jet dash recharge.
tooltip.entropica.cooked_comet_ribbonfis: Grants 30s of Speed and Starlight Grace when eaten.
tooltip.entropica.zenith_moonfish: Caught only in Astral Skerries (most active at night). Tames, heals, and breeds the Starlight Nautilus.
tooltip.entropica.cooked_zenith_moonfish: Clears Darkness & Blindness and grants 45s of Starlight Grace.
tooltip.entropica.supernova_puffer: Starlight Nautilus favorite! Heals 10 HP, overcharges Star-Jet dashes, and may shed Astral Nautilus Nacre.
tooltip.entropica.astral_lanternfish: Rare Astral Skerries night catch. Instantly tames a Starlight Nautilus or grants 2m of Night Vision & Starlight Grace.
